title: sdks: unify auth/retries and streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go; parity fixes + version bump
author: Aisha Thompson
description: Unify SDK behavior across Python, TypeScript, and Go for authentication/token refresh, retry/backoff semantics, and streaming ergonomics. This PR standardizes: 1) automatic token refresh behavior and centralized auth middleware; 2) retry policy defaults (idempotent vs non-idempotent routes), jittered exponential backoff, and hooks for custom retry policies; 3) streaming client ergonomics (consistent cancelation, single event stream interface, and typed payload wrappers); 4) parity fixes so client APIs behave consistently across languages; 5) version bumps and changelog updates for each SDK. Motivation: customers see subtle behavioral diffs between SDKs (e.g. double-refresh race in Python, inconsistent stream cancellation in TS, missing retryable error codes in Go) that complicate cross-team usage and ops. This PR implements language-idiomatic wrappers while keeping same surface area across SDKs, updates tests and docs, and includes migration notes for advanced users. No breaking changes for typical usage; advanced consumers who consumed internal RetryPolicy types should follow the migration guide linked in docs/SDK-MIGRATION.md.
commits_summary: feat(python): centralize auth middleware and token refresh; feat(ts): unify stream event emitter and cancellation API; feat(go): add RetryPolicy hooks and include missing retry codes; docs: migration guide and changelogs; test: add interop and e2e streaming tests; ci: fix flaky streaming e2e
review_comments: Diego Ramirez: Please ensure token refresh is only called once per in-flight refresh; the previous race caused double refresh calls under heavy concurrency.
Aisha Thompson: Addressed by introducing an in-memory singleflight lock in python auth middleware; added unit test to cover concurrent refresh.
Maya Patel: TS API looks good but please add explicit cancelation semantics to ensure consumers can reliably close streams without leaking sockets.
Aisha Thompson: Added StreamController.close() in TS and wired graceful shutdown in runtime; added e2e test that ensures TCP sockets are closed in CI.
Liam O'Connor: Go retries: include 429 and 503 as retryable and default max attempts to 5; also expose hook for instrumentation.
Aisha Thompson: Updated retries.go to include 429/503 and exposed RetryHook interface with example in docs. Added integration test to verify retry on synthetic 429.
Diego Ramirez: CI flake observed in python streaming e2e (timeout) — suggest increasing default test timeout and adding retry around flaky assertion.
Aisha Thompson: Increased timeout and added eventual assertion; CI rerun passed.
Maya Patel: Docs: add migration snippet for users who referenced internal RetryPolicy types; suggested changelog entries for all three SDKs.
Aisha Thompson: Added migration guide and per-sdk changelog bullets. Ready for final review.
